tools.name: validate_target
tools.description: Free. Check that a domain or URL is well-formed and get the normalized hostname, before calling a paid check. Offline: no network request, no payment. Rejects IP addresses, single-label names and URLs with credentials.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Free. Return the price of every paid tool, the payment network (Base) and the receiving address, so you can budget before calling. No input, no network request, no payment.

tools.name: check_cert

tools.name: check_dns
tools.description: Look up the live DNS of a domain: NS, A/AAAA/CNAME, MX, SPF, DMARC, CAA (climbing to the parent zone) and DNSSEC status, with plain-English findings. Use it for a DNS inventory or to debug resolution; use check_email_auth for a deeper SPF/DMARC/DKIM/MTA-STS review. Queries Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_target, check_dns, site_health, check_email_auth, domain_grade, full_site_audit, threat_check, bulk_threat_check, watch_status · Private data: validate_target · Public sink: check_domain_expiry, site_health, check_email_auth, domain_grade, watch_status · Destructive: site_health.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_target, check_dns, site_health, check_email_auth, domain_grade, full_site_audit, threat_check, bulk_threat_check, watch_status · Private data: validate_target · Public sink: check_domain_expiry, site_health, check_email_auth, domain_grade, watch_status · Destructive: site_health

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "watch_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
